client_alerts.headline: Google is starting to link Wallet to AI Mode in Search, with Drive and the Gemini app to follow
client_alerts.body: The link is **opt-in**, but it puts payment and, soon, Drive content inside a consumer AI surface. Clients on Google Workspace should check whether users can turn on these links with work accounts. They should also update their AI acceptable-use policy before the Drive integration arrives in the next few weeks.

top_moves.title: Staff at OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly doubt unreleased models can ship safely
top_moves.body: Axios cites more than two dozen employees across both labs warning that their most capable unreleased models may be too risky to release. OpenAI says it will keep publishing system cards and incident reports. Expect clients' boards to ask about frontier-model risk in vendor and third-party risk reviews.

top_moves.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards
top_moves.body: Claude Ship is a set of agents for code review, fixes and approvals after code is written. Enterprise Frontier Safeguards detects coordinated AI misuse and is offered on the Claude Platform, Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud. Both are new governance controls to cite in client AI-risk advisories.

top_moves.title: OpenAI and Cisco open-source Shirudo, a Linux shield for the window before a patch exists
top_moves.body: One digest reports Shirudo protects Linux systems during the gap before a vendor patch ships. If it holds up, it's a compensating control worth noting in ransomware and DR runbooks. Confirm the details against the primary announcement first.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: Staff safety warnings over unreleased models, plus a reported Shirudo open-source release with Cisco.
providers.detail: Axios reports OpenAI and Anthropic staff doubt that their next frontier models can ship safely, and OpenAI points to system cards and incident reports in response. A digest says OpenAI and Cisco open-sourced Shirudo, a pre-patch protection tool for Linux. GPT-6.2 Sol (covered yesterday) is still rolling into ChatGPT. Reports of $10B in quarterly revenue are not tied to a clear date.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Claude Ship (post-code review agents) and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards launch; IPO trading status still unconfirmed.
providers.detail: Claude Ship covers review, fixes and approvals after code is written. Enterprise Frontier Safeguards detects coordinated misuse across the Claude Platform, Bedrock and Google Cloud. Opus 4.8 fast mode is removed Nov 30. I could not confirm ANT's trading status from today's search.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Google Wallet now links to AI Mode (opt-in), with Drive and the Gemini app coming in the next few weeks.
providers.detail: Google began rolling out an opt-in link between Google Wallet and AI Mode in Search, with Drive and Gemini app links to follow. AlloyDB Omni now integrates with locally hosted LLMs. Gemini 3.5 Pro still has no confirmed release.
providers.alertReason: Drive content is moving into AI Mode. Review Workspace admin controls.

providers.detail: No November release found beyond the Nov 2 retirement of grok-imagine-image-quality. Grok 5 still has no date.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Quiet. Muse Ember (Nov 9) is the latest; Muse Spark 1.2 weights are still unreleased.
providers.detail: No new Llama. Meta's releases now come under the Muse brand. Muse Ember is the small model built for tool calls and extraction, at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet. Large 4 and the new Studio agent features (early November) are the latest.
providers.detail: No new model found this week. Medium 3.5 runs self-hosted on four GPUs, which is still the sovereignty option to mention to clients.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Quiet. Teammates (Max tier, web-only) and the Comet patent search (Nov 6) are the latest.
providers.detail: No new ship found. Native apps for Teammates have been promised but have no date.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Post-Ignite rollout continues; treat Autopilot as announced, not shipped.
providers.detail: The combined Chat and Cowork history and Projects in Copilot Chat are rolling out worldwide in November. Connector write actions are GA. Autopilot's Message Center post still says timing and admin controls will come later.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new ship found; Claude Ship now competes directly with Copilot's review agents.
providers.detail: The latest weekly release I found added Claude Haiku 5.5 (Oct 5). Billing has been usage-based since June.

providers.name: Cursor

providers.detail: Under SpaceXAI ownership. Version 3.24 (Oct 9) is the latest release found.

providers.name: Gamma

providers.detail: No November update found. The late-October context sources (Slack, Notion, Granola) are the last improvements.

providers.detail: No November ship found. Under BYOK, clients can route Notion AI through their own model contracts.
